questions.question: 3 birds fly along the circumference of a jungle. They complete one round in 27 minutes, 45 minutes and 63 minutes, respectively. Since they start together, when will they meet again (in minutes) at the starting position?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

3 birds fly along the circumference of a jungle.

Time Taken by 1st bird to complete one round = 27 minutes.

Time Taken by 2ⁿd bird to complete one round = 45 minutes.

Time Taken by 3rd bird to complete one round = 63 minutes.

**Concept****:**

In circular track 

The time of the first meeting at the starting point is equal to the LCM of time taken by them to cover 1 round.

**Calculation****:**

LCM of 27, 45 & 63

⇒ 27 = 3 × 3 × 3 = 3³

⇒ 45 = 3 × 3 × 5 = 3² × 5

⇒ 63 = 3 × 3 × 7 = 3² × 7

LCM of 27, 45 & 63 = 27 × 5 × 7 = 945

**∴ They meet again at the starting position after 945 minutes.**

questions.question: A is 30% more efficient than B and B can finish a certain job in 13 days. How many days will A alone take to complete the same job?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Total Work = Number of days required × Efficiency

The ratio of efficiency A and B = 13 : 10

Let the efficiency of A & B be 13 units & 10 units respectively

B can finish a certain job in 13 days

Total work = 13 × 10 units = 130 units

Number of days required by A = 130 units ÷ 13 = 10 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A is 30% more efficient than B

B can finish a certain job in 13 days

**Concept:**

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time when the work done is constant

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio of efficiency A and B = 130% : 100%

⇒ Ratio of efficiency A and B = 13 : 10

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time when the work done is constant

The ratio of time Taken by A and B = 10 : 13

Let A takes x days to do the same job

⇒ 10 : 13 ∷ x : 13

⇒ (10/13) ∷ (x/13)

⇒ x = (10 × 13)/13

⇒ x = 10

**∴**** A alone complete the same job in 10 days**

questions.question: The total consumption of rice is 20 kg per month for a family. As the price of rice increases by 35%, the family reduces its consumption so that the expenditure of rice is increased only by 8%. What is the new consumption (in kg) of rice per month due to the increases in the price of rice?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Consumption of rice = 20 kg

The price of rice increases by 35%

Consumption of rice is reduced so as the expenditure increases by 8%

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Consumption (in kg) × Price (of rice)

**Calculation: **

Let the original price of 1 kg of rice is Rs 100

The total price of 20 kg rice = Rs 2000

According to the question

Increased price of rice = 100 × 135% = 135

Increased Expenditure = 2000 × 108% = Rs 2160

New Consumption = 2160 ÷ 135 = 16 kg

**∴ The new consumption (in kg) of rice per month due to the increases in the price of rice is 16.**

questions.question: Radha sold a watch at a profit of 12.5%. If she had sold it for Rs.50 more, then profit would have been 15%. The initial selling price (in Rs) of the watch is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Profit is calculated on CP

Difference between profit = 15% - 12.5% = 2.5%

⇒ 2.5% = 50 Rs

⇒ CP = 100% = 50 × 40 = 2000 Rs

Originally watch was sold at 12.5% profit

⇒ SP = 2000 × (112.5)/(100) = 2250 Rs

∴ The initial selling price of the watch was Rs 2250.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radha sold a watch at a profit of 12.5%

If she had sold it for Rs.50 more, the profit would have been 15%

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (SP-CP)/(CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of a watch be Rs 100a

⇒ SP = 100a × (112.5/100) = Rs 112.5a

According to the question

⇒ S.P + 50 = C.P × (100 + Profit)/100

⇒ S.P + 50 = 100a × (115/100)

⇒ 112.5a + 50 = 115a

⇒ 115a – 112.5a = 50

⇒ 2.5a = 50

⇒ a = Rs 20

Initial SP = 112.5a

⇒ 112.5 × 20 = Rs 2250

**∴ The initial Selling Price of a watch is Rs 2250.**

questions.question: A, B and C agree to pay their total telephone bill in the proportion 3 ∶ 5 ∶ 7. A pays the first month's bill of Rs.360, B pays the second month's bill of Rs.560 and C pays the third month's bill of Rs.840. How much amount (in Rs) should B pay to settle the accounts?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of telephone bills paid by A, B and C = 3 : 5 : 7

Bill paid by A = Rs 360

Bill paid by B = Rs 560

Bill paid by C = Rs 840

**Calculations: **

Let the bill paid by A, B and C be 3x, 5x and 7x respectively

⇒ 7x = 840

⇒ x = 120

Bill payable to B is 5x

⇒ 120 × 5 = Rs 600

The bill paid by B is Rs 560

Remaining amount to be paid by B = 600 - 560 = Rs 40

**∴ The amount B pays to settle the accounts is Rs 40.**

questions.question: Ram sold an article for Rs.1,476, after allowing a 20% discount on its marked price. If he had not allowed any discount, he would have earned a profit of 24%. What is the cost price (in Rs) of the article (correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Cost price = 1476 × (100/80) × (100/124)

⇒ 1487.90 Rs.

∴ The cost price of the article is 1487.90.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

SP of an article is Rs 1,476

20% discount is allowed on MP

If discount was not given, profit would have been 24%

**Concept used:**

Discount = MP - SP

% Discount = (Discount/MP) × 100

MP = SP × [100/(100 - Discount)]

CP = SP × [100/(100 + Profit)]

**Calculation:**

MP = 1476 × 100/(100 - 20)

⇒ 1476 × (100/80) = Rs 1845

CP = 1845 × [100/(100 + 24)]

⇒ 1845 × (100/124) = 1487.90 Rs.

**∴**** The cost price of the article is 1487.90 Rs. **

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at a certain rate of interest is Rs.1,996.80 if the interest is compounded annually, and the simple interest on the same sum for the same time and at the same rate of interest is Rs.1,920. The amount (in Rs) for the same sum, interest compounded annually, at the same rate of interest for 3 years is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CI for 2 years = Rs 1996.80

SI for 2 years = Rs 1920

**Formula used:**

CI = Principle [1 + (Rate/100)]ⁿt - Principle

SI = (Principle × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

**Concept Used:**

Difference of CI & SI for 2ⁿd year = CI of Two Years - SI of Two Years

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Difference of CI & SI for 2nd year = 1996.8 – 1920 = 76.8

SI of two years = 1920

⇒ SI of one year = 1920 ÷ 2 = 960

⇒ Rate = 76.8/960 × 100 = 8%

⇒ Principle = 960 × (100/8) = Rs 12000

Rate = 8%, interest is compounded annually

⇒ Amount = 12000 + [1 + (8/100)]3

⇒ Amount = 12000 + 3116.544 = Rs 15116.544

**∴**** The amount for the 8% interest compounded annually for 3 years is Rs. 15116.544.**
